title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Undefined parameter T in fragmentation c
description: The statement 'With T=0, only one fragmented packet per signed link and data Rule ID may be active' references parameter T without defining it. T is the DTag field size in SCHC (RFC 8724), but this document never introduces or explains T. Readers unfamiliar with SCHC internals will not understand this constraint.
